findings.text: The escaped-descendant test depends on timing: the escaped process must fork, write its PID file and print within the 2-second deadline. On a loaded host it can miss the deadline, so the test fails without the "output pipes remain open" condition, and the `finally` block cannot stop a descendant that has not written its PID yet. Fix: in the injected `cli.py`, poll until `pid_file` exists before `time.sleep(60)`, so the escaped descendant is ready before the deadline whatever the host load.
